# airlock_baseline (Resource)

Manage an Airlock baseline package.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "airlock_baseline" "example" {
  name = "tf-example-baseline"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Baseline name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Airlock object ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import airlock_baseline.example 1700000002
```
